title: Host intake setup - food | hydration | supplement (0|1)

basedOn: Pre-digestion setup (S-0): identify the host, then read which payload channels are present before anything enters the mouth. Chewing and salivary enzymes are the next stage (oral, S-1); this stage is presence + routing only, not digestion. Teaching model - no product score implied.
sources: NIDDK - Your Digestive System & How It Works: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/digestive-diseases/digestive-system-how-it-works
Hall & Hall, Guyton and Hall Textbook of Medical Physiology, 14th ed. - Unit XII, Gastrointestinal Physiology
Boron & Boulpaep, Medical Physiology, 3rd ed. - The Gastrointestinal System

inputs.description: 1 = host profile present enough to receive a packet (boot gate)
1 = solid/meal food packet present this event; 0 = absent
Optional: foreshadow oral form when food=1

hostGate.label: Host ready?
hostGate.detail: Boot gate: the instance must be identifiable before any packet is accepted. Food advice without a host is the Part 0 anti-pattern.

onFail.effect: No host profile - refuse payload; run initialize/configure/calibrate first.

refuseNoHost.label: REFUSE - host not ready
refuseNoHost.detail: Empty machine. Set host.ready = 1 after boot setup. No mouth sequence starts.

packetPresence.label: Read packet flags (food | hydration | supplement)
packetPresence.detail: Each channel is binary presence (0|1), not a score. Multiple can be 1 in one event (e.g. meal + water + pill).

anyPayload.label: Any payload present?
anyPayload.detail: Fail-closed: if food=0 AND hydration=0 AND supplement=0, there is nothing to sequence.

choices.note: All channels off - UNEVALUABLE empty log.

refuseEmpty.label: UNEVALUABLE - empty packet
refuseEmpty.detail: No food, fluid, or supplement flag is on. Unlock: set at least one intake.* = 1.

routePrimary.label: Primary path by payload mix
routePrimary.detail: Food opens the full oral mill. Hydration-only is a liquid transit. Supplement often rides with a swallow of fluid. Co-presence is allowed.

choices.note: Supplement without meal food -> capsule/tablet oral path.
Fluid alone -> liquid oral path (no mastication).

foodPrimary.label: Food packet armed
foodPrimary.detail: Solid/meal food will enter cephalic -> mastication -> bolus. Hydration and supplement flags (if 1) travel as co-payload notes into oral.

edgeCases.effect: Co-fluid present - lubrication and gastric volume teaching note.
Supplement co-event - partners/gates still need named cargo later; presence alone is not a dose.

supplementPrimary.label: Supplement packet armed
supplementPrimary.detail: Capsule/tablet path: usually minimal shear, depends on co-swallowed fluid. Not a meal matrix; cargo must be named before claim scoring.

edgeCases.effect: No co-fluid flagged - teaching risk of incomplete swallow / delayed esophageal transit.

hydrationOnly.label: Hydration-only packet armed
hydrationOnly.detail: Fluid without food/supplement: liquid oral path, no starch/fat oral enzymes required. Still counts as a timed intake event.

handoffOral.label: -> Mouth sequence (S-1)
handoffOral.detail: Intake setup closed. Next machine: stage.oral with intake.* flags still on the context.
